jobs.title: Vice President of Product Design
jobs.description:
I. Position Overview

The Vice President of Product Design is responsible for formulating the company's overall product design strategy and leading product design, user experience (UX), user interface (UI), and design system development. The role ensures that products balance user needs, business objectives, and technical feasibility.

This position is responsible for establishing unified product design methodologies, processes, and standards, and for driving close collaboration between the design team and product, engineering, marketing, customer success, and business teams. Through user research, data analysis, and design innovation, the VP continuously enhances product experience, user satisfaction, and business value.

II. Key Responsibilities
1. Product Design Strategy
Formulate the company's overall product design strategy and long-term design development plan.
Establish a design direction aligned with the company's product strategy and business goals.
Participate in product roadmapping, product positioning, and major product decisions.
Establish standards for user experience, product design, and visual design.
Drive the strategic role of design in product innovation and business growth.
2. UX/UI Design Management
Oversee UX, UI, interaction design, and visual design efforts.
Establish a product design methodology centered on user needs.
Ensure products deliver a clear, consistent, intuitive, and scalable user experience.
Oversee design solutions for complex products and critical user journeys.
Drive consistency in product experiences across web, mobile, and platform environments.
3. User Research and Product Insights
Establish a framework for user research and design insights.
Analyze customer needs, user behaviors, and usage scenarios.
Organize user interviews, usability testing, and customer research.
Translate user research findings into recommendations for product design and optimization.
Collaborate with product management teams to identify UX pain points and opportunities.
4. Design System Development
Build and continuously refine an enterprise-level design system.
Define standards for components, interactions, visuals, and accessibility.
Drive the consistent application of design specifications across different products and teams.
Enhance collaboration efficiency between design and engineering teams.
Establish a management system for design assets, components, and specifications.
5. Product Innovation
Drive design exploration for innovative products and new features.
Participate in "0-to-1" product design and proof-of-concept initiatives. Focus on the impact of emerging technologies—such as AI, data, automation, and digital experiences—on product design.
Drive prototyping, Design Sprints, and experimental design initiatives.
Mitigate product innovation risks through rapid validation.
6. Cross-functional Collaboration
Collaborate with the CPO, product managers, and product teams to define product direction.
Partner with engineering teams to ensure the feasibility of design solutions.
Align with marketing teams to maintain consistency in brand and product experience.
Gather customer feedback in collaboration with Customer Success and Sales teams.
Communicate major product design directions and investment needs to senior management.
7. Design Team Leadership
Oversee the organizational structure and team building of the product design function.
Recruit, mentor, and manage senior design talent and design managers.
Establish frameworks for design leadership, coaching, and career development.
Define team goals, performance metrics, and professional development plans.
Foster a design culture characterized by high standards and strong collaboration.
8. Design Process and Efficiency
Establish a standardized product design process.
Optimize the design workflow: Research → Ideation → Prototyping → Testing → Launch.
Enhance design delivery efficiency and cross-functional collaboration.
Implement design quality review mechanisms.
Drive the adoption of data-driven and experimentation-led methodologies within the design team.
9. Product Experience and Business Value
Leverage design to boost product adoption and user retention.
Analyze the impact of user experience on conversion rates, customer satisfaction, and revenue.
Drive the optimization of key user journeys.
Collaborate with product teams to establish KPIs for product experience.
Ensure design investments deliver tangible product and business value.
III. Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree or higher; majors in Product Design, Industrial Design, Interaction Design, Visual Design, HCI, Computer Science, or related fields are preferred.
Typically requires 20+ years of experience in product design, UX, UI, or related design disciplines.
Typically requires 8+ years of experience in senior design management or design leadership.
Experience managing large-scale or cross-regional product design teams.
Experience designing complex digital products, enterprise-grade software, or platform products.
Familiarity with the end-to-end product design lifecycle.
Strong capabilities in design strategy, user research, and product thinking.
Ability to communicate effectively at the executive level with C-suite, product, engineering, and business teams. Possess strong data analysis and business acumen.

jobs.title: Principal Technical Product Manager, Catalysis
jobs.description:
About SandboxAQ

SandboxAQ is a high-growth company delivering AI solutions that address some of the world's greatest challenges. The company’s Large Quantitative Models (LQMs) power advances in life sciences, financial services, navigation, cybersecurity, and other sectors.

We are a global team that is tech-focused and includes experts in AI, chemistry, cybersecurity, physics, mathematics, medicine, engineering, and other specialties. The company emerged from Alphabet Inc. as an independent, growth capital-backed company in 2022, funded by leading investors and supported by a braintrust of industry leaders.

At SandboxAQ, we’ve cultivated an environment that encourages creativity, collaboration, and impact. By investing deeply in our people, we’re building a thriving, global workforce poised to tackle the world's epic challenges. Join us to advance your career in pursuit of an inspiring mission, in a community of like-minded people who value entrepreneurialism, ownership, and transformative impact.

The Opportunity

SandboxAQ’s AI Simulation (AISim) division develops and applies Large Quantitative Models (LQMs) that are grounded in physics, chemistry, mathematics and biology to simulate molecular behavior with scientific precision and accelerate discovery in the physical world across biopharma, chemicals, advanced materials, healthcare, and so much more.

Within AISim, ChemSim is SandboxAQ's AI-driven materials discovery platform. We are seeking an exceptional Product Manager to own the Catalysis vertical. This is a dual-mandate role. In the near term, you will be the product owner for catalysis within SandboxAQ's $500M CHIPS Act R&D award from the U.S. Department of Commerce, translating contractual objectives into product requirements and external fulfilment, whilst partnering with Program Managers to ensure successful milestone delivery. In parallel, you will build the commercial foundation that turns catalysis from a government-funded R&D workstream into a product-led business generating durable, recurring revenue from the broader materials and process-chemistry market.

Catalysis is one of the largest and most consequential application areas in applied chemistry. It underpins refining and downstream oil and gas, commodity and petrochemical production, emissions control, and the energy transition (hydrogen electrolysis, carbon utilization, e-fuels and chemical recycling etc) alongside semiconductor process chemistry and fine chemical synthesis. Across nearly all of these markets the bottleneck is the same: catalyst discovery and optimization remain slow, experimental and expensive, and the simulation tools available today answer narrower questions than the ones that actually decide a process. This is a once-in-a-career opportunity to shape a category-defining AI platform for materials science at the intersection of national security, scientific discovery, and commercial scale.

Key Responsibilities

Own the end-to-end Catalysis product strategy, vision and roadmap, spanning CHIPS Act contractual deliverables, vertical scientific depth, and commercial expansion into new markets.
Build a deep understanding of customer needs by working closely with Application Scientists and the Business Development team. Synthesize field insights, application benchmarking data, and market feedback into a clear picture of customer personas, and performance drivers, and translate these into prioritized product requirements and specifications.
Translate the program's catalysis objectives into clear product requirements, a vertical roadmap, and the evidence packages required for Fulfillment Notices to the U.S. Department of Commerce.
Define the dataset and model requirements for the vertical, chemical coverage, fidelity, and the benchmarking that determines where simulation investment is directed in partnership with our scientific and ML teams.
Drive the roadmap from property and energetics prediction toward reaction-level modelling, so that predictions can be validated against a customer's own process rather than assessed in isolation.
Quantify the value our catalyst products and services create for customers, such as gains in yield, selectivity, catalyst life, energy efficiency, and emissions. Equip Go-to-Market, Application Science, and Business Development teams with compelling value propositions, value models, and commercialization strategies that help them turn that technical performance into revenue, market share, and long-term customer partnerships.
Contribute to the catalysis commercial strategy with commercial leadership: customer segmentation, scope of offer, packaging, and pricing model across semiconductor, refining and petrochemical, emissions control and energy-transition customers.
Build, manage, and own strategic partner relationships at the product level: Work with fabs and equipment OEMs, precursor and specialty materials suppliers, refiners and chemical producers, catalyst manufacturers, national laboratories and validation partners, translating partner requirements into product features.
Define and track strategic product and commercial KPIs: Manage the metrics that matter most including, Model accuracy requirements, workflow adoption, customer segment expansion, and recurring revenue growth , and drive course corrections against OKRs.
Develop and defend build-vs-buy and build-vs-partner recommendations for domain-specific scientific engines, datasets and validation tooling.
Serve as the primary product voice for catalysis to program stakeholders, semiconductor ecosystem partners, and prospective commercial customers.
Define which parts of the roadmap are shared capability across end markets and which are market-specific, so that expansion compounds the product rather than fragmenting it.

Essential Skills & Experience

5+ years in product management, including ownership of a technically deep product sold to external customers. Must be able to operate in a product capacity within business models that are software and service oriented
Strong domain grounding in materials science, catalysis, chemistry, or chemical engineering. Enough knowledge to sufficiently and credibly engage computational scientists, experimental validation partners, and domain SMEs.
Track record shipping AI/ML-driven scientific or engineering software to external, paying or contracted users; and shipping products where the ICP was not clearly understood or demand generation and funnel was not already in place.
Experience contributing to scope of offer, packaging and pricing decisions for technical software, or clear evidence of the commercial instinct to do so.
Ability to engage both computational scientists and industrial, refining, chemical or equipment OEM partners, and to turn partner requirements into product requirements.
Ability to reason commercially across multiple end markets at once, sizing opportunities, comparing them on evidence, and sequencing entry rather than pursuing all of them simultaneously.
Comfort navigating deep ambiguity: translating unclear scientific and customer problems into structured roadmaps, success criteria, and measurable outcomes.
Has an ownership mindset, and a rigorous operational execution track record.
Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering or Materials Science or equivalent practical experience.

Highly Desired Skills & Experience

Experience in one or more major catalysis end markets, refining and downstream, petrochemicals and commodity chemicals, emissions control, or energy-transition catalysis such as electrolysis, carbon utilization, e-fuels or chemical recycling.
Familiarity with computational chemistry workflows such as density functional theory (DFT), molecular dynamics, or microkinetic modelling, and the judgement to evaluate technical feasibility and roadmap trade-offs.
Semiconductor or electronic materials process chemistry experience (e.g. deposition, etch, wafer cleaning, gas abatement etc).
Familiarity with homogeneous or solution-phase catalysis alongside heterogeneous surface chemistry, and a view on where each approach applies.
Understanding of machine-learned interatomic potentials, spin polarization in transition-metal systems, and the evaluation of ML models against experimental or first-principles reference data.
Track record building product-led growth motions for technical or scientific software, including self-serve adoption and land-and-expand commercial models.
Prior product or business development engagement with catalyst manufacturers, chemical producers, refiners, or semiconductor ecosystem partners such as fabs, equipment OEMs and precursor suppliers.
Experience with multi-tenant SaaS, API governance, and enterprise security and compliance requirements.
An advanced degree in Computational Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Catalysis, Materials Science, or a related field.

Why Join Us?

We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and life outside of work.

Career Defining Work: Your work will directly accelerate the discovery of better drugs and better materials, advance human health, and enable safer and more sustainable technologies by helping customers put AI Simulation capabilities into real world use.
Compensation: Competitive base salary, performance-based incentives or bonuses (where applicable), and equity participation.
Benefits: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents with generous employer premium contributions, retirement savings with company matching, paid parental leave, and inclusive family-building benefits.
Work-Life Balance: Fully remote, Flexible paid time off, company-wide seasonal breaks, and support for flexible work arrangements that enable sustainable performance.
Learning and Growth: Opportunities for continuous learning and growth through on-the-job development, cross-functional collaboration, and access to internal learning and development programs.

SandboxAQ Welcomes All

We are committed to fostering a culture of belonging and respect, where diverse perspectives are actively sought and valued. Our multidisciplinary environment provides ample opportunity for continuous growth - working alongside humble, empowered, and ambitious colleagues ready to tackle epic challenges.

Equal Employment Opportunity
: All qualified applicants will receive consideration regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status.

Accommodations
: We provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities in job application procedures for open roles. If you need such an accommodation, please let a member of our Recruiting team know.

jobs.title: Digital / Sr Digital Product Manager
jobs.description:
As a Senior Digital Product Manager, you lead cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact, customer-centric solutions that align with company strategy. You own complex product domains or capabilities, deeply understand customer pain points, and translate strategy into a clear roadmap with measurable outcomes. You operate with autonomy and are trusted to drive results across teams.

Essential Functions

Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for a critical product area or customer journey
Lead discovery work—customer interviews, competitive research, and data analysis—to identify opportunities
Collaborate closely with engineering, design, marketing, and operations to build and launch solutions
Define and track KPIs to evaluate feature success and inform iteration
Drive prioritization across competing demands and communicate rationale clearly to stakeholders
Influence cross-functional leaders and executives to gain buy-in on product direction
Mentor junior PMs and support organizational learning and best practices

Location Details:

This position is eligible for remote work and may be located anywhere within the United States excluding AK, HI and U.S. territories, however if you live within the 50 miles radius of a campus you will be required to work at a FedEx campus location several times per week.

Preferred Qualifications
:

Experience owning product strategy, roadmap development, and lifecycle management for high-scale API products, platforms, or enterprise integrations.
Demonstrated ability to translate customer, business, and developer requirements into scalable platform capabilities and prioritized product roadmaps.
Demonstrated success in managing end-to-end API product offerings, including API contracts, schemas, developer experience, documentation, versioning, backward compatibility, and lifecycle governance.
Proven track record of working as an AI-native Product Manager and identifying opportunities to incorporate AI, GenAI, and agentic capabilities into digital products and platforms.
Skilled in defining and delivering agent-ready capabilities that enable AI agents to securely discover, access, and interact with enterprise data and services.
Strong partnership skills with Engineering and Architecture teams, with the ability to influence API design, scalability, security, authentication, authorization, performance, resiliency, and technical trade-off decisions.
Expertise in establishing and monitoring product success metrics, including adoption, transaction volume, availability, latency, error rates, data quality, reliability, and operational performance.
Demonstrated use of customer insights, analytics, experimentation, and quantitative data to identify opportunities, address product gaps, and prioritize investments.
Experience managing high-scale, mission-critical APIs, API platforms, developer platforms, or related technical products.
Proven ability to work deeply with cross-functional technical teams and make informed product decisions involving complex architectural and engineering considerations.
Experience with AI/GenAI products, agentic AI, Model Context Protocol (MCP), or developing APIs, tools, and platforms designed for AI agents is strongly preferred.

Minimum Education

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.

Minimum Experience

4 years of experience in product management, business analysis, or a related field.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Demonstrated ability to manage stakeholder relationships, facilitate communication, and drive execution.
Strong analytical skills with experience in data interpretation, market research, and business case analysis.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with experience preparing executive-level presentations.

new_jobs.description:
As a Senior Digital Product Manager, you lead cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact, customer-centric solutions that align with company strategy. You own complex product domains or capabilities, deeply understand customer pain points, and translate strategy into a clear roadmap with measurable outcomes. You operate with autonomy and are trusted to drive results across teams.

Essential Functions

Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for a critical product area or customer journey
Lead discovery work—customer interviews, competitive research, and data analysis—to identify opportunities
Collaborate closely with engineering, design, marketing, and operations to build and launch solutions
Define and track KPIs to evaluate feature success and inform iteration
Drive prioritization across competing demands and communicate rationale clearly to stakeholders
Influence cross-functional leaders and executives to gain buy-in on product direction
Mentor junior PMs and support organizational learning and best practices

Location Details:

This position is eligible for remote work and may be located anywhere within the United States excluding AK, HI and U.S. territories, however if you live within the 50 miles radius of a campus you will be required to work at a FedEx campus location several times per week.

Preferred Qualifications
:

Experience owning product strategy, roadmap development, and lifecycle management for high-scale API products, platforms, or enterprise integrations.
Demonstrated ability to translate customer, business, and developer requirements into scalable platform capabilities and prioritized product roadmaps.
Demonstrated success in managing end-to-end API product offerings, including API contracts, schemas, developer experience, documentation, versioning, backward compatibility, and lifecycle governance.
Proven track record of working as an AI-native Product Manager and identifying opportunities to incorporate AI, GenAI, and agentic capabilities into digital products and platforms.
Skilled in defining and delivering agent-ready capabilities that enable AI agents to securely discover, access, and interact with enterprise data and services.
Strong partnership skills with Engineering and Architecture teams, with the ability to influence API design, scalability, security, authentication, authorization, performance, resiliency, and technical trade-off decisions.
Expertise in establishing and monitoring product success metrics, including adoption, transaction volume, availability, latency, error rates, data quality, reliability, and operational performance.
Demonstrated use of customer insights, analytics, experimentation, and quantitative data to identify opportunities, address product gaps, and prioritize investments.
Experience managing high-scale, mission-critical APIs, API platforms, developer platforms, or related technical products.
Proven ability to work deeply with cross-functional technical teams and make informed product decisions involving complex architectural and engineering considerations.
Experience with AI/GenAI products, agentic AI, Model Context Protocol (MCP), or developing APIs, tools, and platforms designed for AI agents is strongly preferred.

Minimum Education

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.

Minimum Experience

4 years of experience in product management, business analysis, or a related field.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Demonstrated ability to manage stakeholder relationships, facilitate communication, and drive execution.
Strong analytical skills with experience in data interpretation, market research, and business case analysis.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with experience preparing executive-level presentations.
